get.description: Finds web search results in Tavily by query.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: chunksPerSource
parameters.description: The maximum number of relevant content chunks to return per source when search depth is advanced.

schema.description: The maximum number of relevant content chunks to return per source when search depth is advanced.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Prioritize search results from a specific country when topic is general.

schema.description: Prioritize search results from a specific country when topic is general.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Return results before this date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.description: Return results before this date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: excludeDomains[]
parameters.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results.

schema.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results.

parameters.name: includeAnswer
parameters.description: Include an LLM-generated answer. Accepted values are false, true, basic, or advanced.

schema.description: Include an LLM-generated answer. Accepted values are false, true, basic, or advanced.

parameters.name: includeDomains[]
parameters.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results.

schema.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results.

parameters.name: includeImageDescriptions
parameters.description: When include images is true, also return a description for each image.

schema.description: When include images is true, also return a description for each image.

parameters.name: includeRawContent
parameters.description: Include cleaned HTML content from each result. Accepted values are false, true, markdown, or text.

schema.description: Include cleaned HTML content from each result. Accepted values are false, true, markdown, or text.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query to execute with Tavily.

schema.description: The search query to execute with Tavily.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Return results after this date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.description: Return results after this date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the search request.

schema.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the search request.

parameters.name: timeRange

schema.description: The time range back from the current date to filter results by publish or update date.

parameters.name: searchDepth
parameters.description: Controls the latency versus relevance tradeoff for the search.

schema.description: Controls the latency versus relevance tradeoff for the search.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The category of the search.

schema.description: The category of the search.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

schema.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

parameters.name: includeImages
parameters.description: Also perform an image search and include image results.

schema.description: Also perform an image search and include image results.

parameters.name: includeFavicon
parameters.description: Include favicon URLs for each result when available.

schema.description: Include favicon URLs for each result when available.

parameters.name: autoParameters
parameters.description: Automatically configure search parameters based on the query intent.

schema.description: Automatically configure search parameters based on the query intent.

parameters.description: Include credit usage information in the response.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

answer.description: LLM-generated answer when include_answer is requested.

follow_up_questions.description: Suggested follow-up questions when provided by Tavily.

images.description: Image search results when include_images is enabled.

query.description: The search query that was executed.

response_time.description: Time in seconds it took to complete the request.

results.description: Ranked search results returned by Tavily.
